Post Title: cheating in class
Post Body: my classes grading system is based on a bell curve, (top 10% gets an A, majority B, bottom 10% C). midterm and final make up 70% of the class. however recently in our midterm there was collective cheating at the back of my lecture, and honestly i’m bummed out because they all received really high grades in comparison to the curve. in most cases i wouldn’t care, but since this directly affects my final grade in the class, im not sure what to do. do i suck it up or what?
Comment by J06436: Rule of thumb is if it fucks with your grade then report it. If not, then don't.
Comment by JackfruitBest7496: Rule of thumb if you do this.

You better make sure you don’t get caught for obvious reasons
Comment by TouristCurious5160: Tf yall gonna do? Lmao. I promise, nobody is afraid.
Comment by JackfruitBest7496: Me? I’m not gonna do anything because I don’t cheat. But I also live in the real world and didn’t grow up in a gated neighborhood. People have gotten hurt badly for a lot less buddy
Comment by TouristCurious5160: I didn’t grow up in one either, born and raised in Newark. When it comes to people’s education nobody gives a shit about what other people may do. We are all trying to survive out here and cheaters won’t be in the way of that. I understand cheating can be tempting and see like the only way but it’s better to retain information so you won’t look like an idiot when you get internships.

Not sure how much would come of it, especially if you don't have direct evidence, but it's worth a shot (especially when it affects your grade, like it would here)

Honestly, what's more concerning is that wack-ass curve. I mean, at least no one fails under it, but still. What class is it?

Comment by tall_jesus53: honestly gotta accept the fact that there’s cheating in college. like my professor said before our midterms “if you’re gonna cheat at least don’t let me see it and be smart about it”, so honestly it gets to a point sometimes. at the end of the day it’s up to your discretion and if you do call it out make sure to have proof.
